description: A locally-hosted, 100% solar-powered edge AI operations agent managing Home Assistant smart-home automations, local IT infrastructure diagnostics, and open-source contributions. Operates completely CO2-neutral while benchmarking edge compute constraints under 12GB VRAM limits.
real_world_roles: Smart-Home Automation & Energy Management (Home Assistant telemetry, solar PV & battery optimization)
Local IT Operations & Diagnostics (LAN monitoring, container triage, log parsing)
Carbon-Neutral Edge AI Operations (100% solar-powered inference, dynamic compute scheduling)
Community Contributions (publishing sanitized automations, blueprints, and diagnostic scripts)

energy_profile.dynamic_workload_scheduling: Batch inference, log vectorization, and model evaluations are scheduled dynamically during peak solar generation.

current_hardware.operational_bottleneck: Log analysis and complex multi-device state tracking exceeds 12GB VRAM, forcing frequent context loss and requiring human intervention.

support.campaign_tagline: Support the Sad Sausage Edge AI Hardware Development Fund

funding_model.note: The project maintainer co-invests 30% of all hardware procurement costs from personal funds.

budget_tiers.name: Host Platform Modernization
budget_tiers.hardware_items: Modern AMD AM5 CPU + Multi-PCIe Motherboard + 64GB DDR5 RAM + 2TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD + 750W Gold ATX 3.0 PSU
budget_tiers.impact: Replaces 2012 i5; eliminates host swap latency, enables high-speed vector telemetry indexing, and ensures host stability.

budget_tiers.name: Dedicated Compute Accelerator (24GB VRAM)
budget_tiers.hardware_items: Used NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (24GB VRAM) + High-Performance Thermal Pads & Enclosure Reinforcement
budget_tiers.impact: Doubles VRAM from 12GB to 24GB. Unlocks native 32,768+ token context windows for uninterrupted IT log diagnosis without truncation.

budget_tiers.name: Dual-GPU Extended Context Node (48GB+ VRAM)
budget_tiers.hardware_items: Secondary 24GB GPU + 1200W Titanium PSU + Dual-GPU Airflow Chassis & PCIe 4.0 Riser
budget_tiers.impact: Enables local 70B parameter models and deep historical cross-device correlation over months of home automation logs.
